name: landmarkmap_boundary
title: LandMark: Indigenous Peoples' and Community Lands
description: Indigenous Peoples' and local community lands and territories from LandMark, combining LandMark's point and polygon layers (points buffered to small 100m polygons).
details: Same combined feature set as the feature-type landmarkmap dataset. Source polygon geometry was 3D; the Z dimension was dropped (not meaningful for these boundaries).
citation: LandMark: The Global Platform of Indigenous and Community Lands. https://landmarkmap.org/
group_title: LandMark: Indigenous Peoples' and Community Lands
